rows.title: Recognise
notes: “We started off with something new from Sydney, Sydney, he says no, Melbourne artist Alice Isabella with a song from her called Recognise”
Melbourne indie-pop singer-songwriter; 'Recognise' is her second single (2026), following 'Crawl'.

rows.title: Gayle
notes: “what about Gale by Melbourne artist Guy Blackman? Sounds like this”
Track from Melbourne musician Guy Blackman's 2008 solo album 'Adult Baby' (ASR misheard 'Gayle' as 'Gale').

rows.title: Eleanor Rigby
notes: “This now is a cover of a Beatles song. It's a name song, Eleanor Rigby, done by Nursery Crimes”
Beatles cover by Melbourne hardcore punk band Nursery Crimes, released as a 1991 7" single and on their 1992 album 'Fun Hurts!'.

notes: “also from Melbourne after that little spoken word intro, it was Polyman with a new song called Walking in Circles”
mentioned by the presenter but we couldn't work out when it played
